frozen_reference.source_excerpt: All welds shall be leak tested either during assembly or acceptance testing.

frozen_reference.source_excerpt: Either non-destructive acceptance testing shall be accomplished or the risk of defects be mitigated through process control.
frozen_reference.engineering_meaning: Defect risk shall be addressed by either performing non-destructive acceptance testing or mitigating defect risk through process control.
normalized_constraints: Perform non-destructive acceptance testing OR mitigate defect risk through process control.

frozen_reference.source_excerpt: If process control is used, approval shall be obtained from the NASA Fracture Control Board
frozen_reference.engineering_meaning: If process control is used, NASA Fracture Control Board approval shall be obtained for spacecraft requiring such approval in programmatic requirements.

frozen_reference.coverage_or_condition: Conditional on use of process control and applicability of the programmatic approval requirement.

frozen_reference.engineering_meaning: When fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, demonstrate to the fracture control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack size is non-credible, based on relevant quality-control and manufacturing knowledge.
